inlines.v: ER'RHINE, adjective er'rine. [Gr. the nose.] Affecting the nose, or to be snuffed into the nose; occasioning discharges from the nose. ER'RHINE, noun er'rine. A medicine to be snuffed up the nose, to promote discharges of mucus.
